new_scholarship.description: The CeMM doctoral programme in molecular technologies and systems medicine, run with AITHYRA and university partners, recruits fully funded PhD positions in molecular medicine and biomedical AI in Vienna. CeMM states it was established in 2006 and has attracted students from 44 countries, with more than 115 graduates and 84 current doctoral researchers. Eligibility requires a relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree, at least a 2:1 or first-class result, significant research experience for Bachelor's holders, and excellent English, since English is the working language. Selection is multi-stage: online application, faculty review, a video interview, an online panel interview, a stated preference of research groups and an in-person match-making event in April for which CeMM covers travel, accommodation and visa support, with positions typically offered within a week of the final interviews. The previous joint AITHYRA-CeMM call closed on 30 January 2026; AITHYRA has announced that it will open a new call in September 2026 for a programme starting September 2027.
